items.title: Amazon Aurora MySQL 8.4.8 (compatible with MySQL 8.4.8) is now generally available
items.blurb: Starting today, Amazon Aurora MySQL-Compatible Edition 8.4 will support MySQL 8.4.8.

items.title: Amazon Aurora MySQL now supports multi-source replication and delayed replication
items.blurb: Starting today, Amazon Aurora MySQL supports two new replication capabilities: multi-source replication and delayed replication.

items.title: Amazon Redshift rg.large instances now support single-node clusters
items.blurb: Amazon Redshift rg.large instances, powered by AWS Graviton processors, now support single-node clusters. Single-node support for rg.large clusters is available on P204 or later patch versions.

items.title: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio Workflows support Python and Bash operators
items.blurb: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio Workflows now supports PythonOperator and BashOperator, enabling you to run custom Python functions and shell commands directly in your serverless workflows without provisioning separate compute resources.

items.title: Amazon MWAA adds built-in monitoring with Amazon CloudWatch
items.blurb: Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (MWAA) now includes a built-in monitoring experience on the environment detail page in the AWS Management Console .

items.title: Zone Redundancy Comes to API Management Standard v2
items.blurb: Microsoft has enabled zone redundancy on the Standard v2 tier of Azure API Management, following its arrival on Premium v2 in December.

items.title: Amazon Linux 2027 is now available in public preview
items.blurb: Today, AWS announces the public preview of Amazon Linux 2027 (AL2027), the next version of the Amazon Linux operating system, purpose-built for cloud-native workloads on AWS with performance, scale, and security in mind.
